function v_u_1.GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame(p28) -- name: GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v29 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
	local _, v30, _ = v29:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()

		local v33 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand)

		local v35 = v29.Position - v33.Position

		local v40 = v35.Z

			v41 = v41 - 6.283185307179586

function v_u_1.calculateRawMoveVector(p63, p64, p65) -- name: calculateRawMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_62
	local v66 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v66 then
		return p65
	end
	local v67 = v66.CFrame
	if v_u_8.VREnabled and p64.RootPart then
		v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
		local v68 = p63:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()
		if (v66.Focus.Position - v67.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
			v67 = v67 * v68
		else
			v67 = v66.CFrame * (v68.Rotation + v68.Position * v66.HeadScale)
		end
	end
	if p64:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		local _, _, _, v73, v70, v71, _, _, v72, _, _, v73 = v67:GetComponents()
		if v72 >= 1 or v72 <= -1 then
			v71 = -v70 * math.sign(v72)
		end
		local v74 = v73 * v73 + v71 * v71
		local v75 = math.sqrt(v74)
		local v76 = (v73 * p65.X + v71 * p65.Z) / v75
		local v77 = (v73 * p65.Z - v71 * p65.X) / v75
		return Vector3.new(v76, 0, v77)
	end
	if not v_u_8.VREnabled then
		return v67:VectorToWorldSpace(p65)
	end
	local v78 = p65.X
	local v79 = p65.Z
	local v80 = Vector3.new(v78, 0, v79)
	if v80.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v81 = -v_u_62().Y * 1.3962634015954636
	local v82 = -v80.X
	local v83 = -v80.Z
	local v84 = math.atan2(v82, v83)
	local _, v85, _ = v67:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v86 = v84 + v85
	return CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(v81, v86, 0).LookVector
end
function v_u_1.OnRenderStepped(p87, p88) -- name: OnRenderStepped
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_2
	if p87.activeController and (p87.activeController.enabled and p87.humanoid) then
		local v89 = p87.activeController:GetMoveVector()
		local v90 = p87.activeController:IsMoveVectorCameraRelative()
		local v91 = p87:GetClickToMoveController()
		if p87.activeController == v91 then
			v91:OnRenderStepped(p88)
		elseif v89.magnitude > 0 then
			v91:CleanupPath()
		else
			v91:OnRenderStepped(p88)
			v89 = v91:GetMoveVector()
			v90 = v91:IsMoveVectorCameraRelative()
		end
		if p87.vehicleController then
			local v92
			v89, v92 = p87.vehicleController:Update(v89, v90, p87.activeControlModule == v_u_10)
		end
		if v90 then

		end
		p87.inputMoveVector = v89
		if v_u_8.VREnabled then
			v89 = p87:updateVRMoveVector(v89)
		end
		p87.moveFunction(v_u_2.LocalPlayer, v89, false)
		local v93 = not p87.activeController:GetIsJumping() and p87.touchJumpController
		if v93 then
			v93 = p87.touchJumpController:GetIsJumping()
		end
		if v93 == true and p87.noJump ~= nil then
			v93 = false
		end

	end
end

	v_u_14:Fire("targetPoint", p27.currentDestination)
end
function v_u_17.GoToPoint(p30, p31) -- name: GoToPoint
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	currentPath = true
	currentPoints = { p31 }
	currentPointIdx = 1
	moving = true
	local v32 = p30:GetLocalHumanoid()
	local v33 = (v32.Torso.Position - p31).magnitude / v32.WalkSpeed
	timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
	expectedTimeToNextPoint = v33
	v_u_14:Fire("targetPoint", p31)
end
function v_u_17.StopFollowingPath(p34) -- name: StopFollowingPath
	currentPath = nil
	currentPoints = nil
	currentPointIdx = 0
	moving = false
	p34.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
function v_u_17.TryComputePath(_, p35, p36) -- name: TryComputePath
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v37 = nil
	local v38 = 0
	while not v37 and v38 < 5 do
		v37 = v_u_5:ComputeSmoothPathAsync(p35, p36, 200)
		v38 = v38 + 1
		if v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.ClosestNoPath or v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.ClosestOutOfRange then
			return nil
		end
		if v37 and v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.FailStartNotEmpty then
			p35 = p35 + (p36 - p35).Unit
			v37 = nil
		end
		if v37 and v37.Status == Enum.PathStatus.FailFinishNotEmpty then
			p36 = p36 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			v37 = nil
		end
	end
	return v37
end
function v_u_17.OnNavigationRequest(p39, p40, _) -- name: OnNavigationRequest
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
	local v41 = p40.Position
	local v42 = p39.currentDestination
	local v43 = v41.x
	local v44
	if v43 == v43 and v43 ~= (1 / 0) then
		v44 = v43 ~= (-1 / 0)
	else
		v44 = false
	end
	if v44 then
		local v45 = v41.y
		if v45 == v45 and v45 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v44 = v45 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v44 = false
		end
		if v44 then
			local v46 = v41.z
			if v46 == v46 and v46 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v44 = v46 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v44 = false
			end
		end
	end
	if v44 then
		p39.currentDestination = v41
		local v47 = p39:GetLocalHumanoid()
		if v47 and v47.Torso then
			local v48 = v47.Torso.Position
			if (p39.currentDestination - v48).magnitude < 12 then
				p39:GoToPoint(p39.currentDestination)
			elseif v42 and (p39.currentDestination - v42).magnitude <= 4 then
				if moving then
					p39.currentPoints[#currentPoints] = p39.currentDestination
					return
				end
				p39:GoToPoint(p39.currentDestination)
			else
				local v49 = p39:TryComputePath(v48, p39.currentDestination)
				if v49 then
					p39:StartFollowingPath(v49)
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(p39.currentPoints)
						v_u_10.renderPath()
						return
					end
				else
					p39:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_17.ControlCharacterGamepad(p54, _, p55, p56) -- name: ControlCharacterGamepad
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_14
	if p56.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
		if p55 ~= Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
			if p55 == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				if p54:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
					p54:BindJumpAction(false)
					p54:SetLaserPointerMode("Navigation")
				end
				if p54.moveLatch then
					p54.moveLatch = false
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
			else
				p54:StopFollowingPath()
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
				end
				if p54:ShouldUseNavigationLaser() then
					p54:BindJumpAction(true)
					p54:SetLaserPointerMode("Hidden")
				end
				if p56.Position.magnitude > 0.22 then
					local v57 = p56.Position.X
					local v58 = -p56.Position.Y
					p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(v57, 0, v58)
					if p54.moveVector.magnitude > 0 then
						local v59 = p54.moveVector.unit
						local v60 = p56.Position.magnitude
						p54.moveVector = v59 * math.min(1, v60)
					end
					p54.moveLatch = true
				end
			end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
		p54.moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_17.OnHeartbeat(p61, p62) -- name: OnHeartbeat
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14
	local v63 = p61.moveVector
	local v64 = p61:GetLocalHumanoid()
	if v64 and v64.Torso then
		if p61.moving and p61.currentPoints then
			local v65 = v64.Torso.Position
			local v66 = (currentPoints[1] - v65) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			local v67 = v66.magnitude
			local v68 = v66 / v67
			if v67 < 1 then
				local v69 = currentPoints[1]
				local v70 = 0
				for v71, v72 in pairs(currentPoints) do
					if v71 ~= 1 then
						v70 = v70 + (v72 - v69).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
						v69 = v72
					end
				end
				table.remove(currentPoints, 1)
				currentPointIdx = currentPointIdx + 1
				if #currentPoints == 0 then
					p61:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					return
				end
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_10.setCurrentPoints(currentPoints)
					v_u_10.renderPath()
				end
				expectedTimeToNextPoint = (currentPoints[1] - v65).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
				timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
			else
				if v_u_13 then
					v_u_12.FilterDescendantsInstances = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v73 = workspace:Raycast(v65 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v68 * 3, v_u_12)
					if v73 then
						local v74 = workspace:Raycast(v73.Position + v68 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0), v_u_12).Position.Y - v65.Y
						if v74 < 6 and v74 > -2 then
							v64.Jump = true
						end
					end
				else
					local v75 = { game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
					local v76 = Ray.new(v65 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v68 * 3)
					local v77, v78, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v76, v75)
					if v77 then
						local v79 = Ray.new(v78 + v68 * 0.5 + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(-0, -100, -0))
						local _, v80, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v79, v75)
						local v81 = v80.Y - v65.Y
						if v81 < 6 and v81 > -2 then
							v64.Jump = true
						end
					end
				end
				if tick() - timeReachedLastPoint > expectedTimeToNextPoint + 2 then
					p61:StopFollowingPath()
					if v_u_10 then
						v_u_10.clearRenderedPath()
					end
					v_u_14:Fire("offtrack")
				end
				v63 = p61.moveVector:Lerp(v68, p62 * 10)
			end
		end
		local v82 = v63.x
		local v83
		if v82 == v82 and v82 ~= (1 / 0) then
			v83 = v82 ~= (-1 / 0)
		else
			v83 = false
		end
		if v83 then
			local v84 = v63.y
			if v84 == v84 and v84 ~= (1 / 0) then
				v83 = v84 ~= (-1 / 0)
			else
				v83 = false
			end
			if v83 then
				local v85 = v63.z
				if v85 == v85 and v85 ~= (1 / 0) then
					v83 = v85 ~= (-1 / 0)
				else
					v83 = false
				end
			end
		end
		if v83 then
			p61.moveVector = v63
		end
	end
end

	function v_u_128.IsCurrentWaypointReached(_) -- name: IsCurrentWaypointReached
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_128
		local v157

			v157 = true
		else

	function v_u_128.OnPointReached(_, p160) -- name: OnPointReached

				end

			p16.cachedParts[p17] = true
			p16.transparencyDirty = true

end
function v_u_7.TeardownTransparency(p19) -- name: TeardownTransparency

		v20.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
	end

	p19.transparencyDirty = true
	p19.lastTransparency = nil

		p19.descendantAddedConn:disconnect()
		p19.descendantAddedConn = nil

		p19.descendantRemovingConn:disconnect()
		p19.descendantRemovingConn = nil
	end

	end
end
function v_u_7.SetupTransparency(p_u_25, p_u_26) -- name: SetupTransparency
	p_u_25:TeardownTransparency()
	if p_u_25.descendantAddedConn then
		p_u_25.descendantAddedConn:disconnect()
	end
	p_u_25.descendantAddedConn = p_u_26.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p27)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_25, (copy) p_u_26
		if p_u_25:IsValidPartToModify(p27) then

				p_u_25.toolDescendantAddedConns[p27]:Disconnect()

				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_25

					p28.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
				end
			end)

				p_u_25.toolDescendantRemovingConns[p27]:disconnect()
			end
			p_u_25.toolDescendantRemovingConns[p27] = p27.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(p29)
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_26, (ref) p_u_25

					p_u_25.cachedParts[p29] = true
					p_u_25.transparencyDirty = true
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	if p_u_25.descendantRemovingConn then
		p_u_25.descendantRemovingConn:disconnect()
	end
	p_u_25.descendantRemovingConn = p_u_26.DescendantRemoving:connect(function(p30)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_25
		if p_u_25.cachedParts[p30] then
			p_u_25.cachedParts[p30] = nil
			p30.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
		end
	end)
	p_u_25:CachePartsRecursive(p_u_26)
end

function v_u_7.Update(p36, p37) -- name: Update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1
	local v38 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v38 and p36.enabled then
		local v39 = (v38.Focus.p - v38.CoordinateFrame.p).magnitude
		local v40 = v39 < 2 and 1 - (v39 - 0.5) / 1.5 or 0
		local v41 = v40 < 0.5 and 0 or v40

			local v42 = v41 - p36.lastTransparency
			local v43 = 2.8 * p37
			local v44 = -v43

			v41 = p36.lastTransparency + v45
		else
			p36.transparencyDirty = true
		end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1

		return nil, nil
	end

	local v14 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v15 = v14.CFrame
	local v16 = v14.Focus

		v15 = v16 * CFrame.new(0, 0, p10:StepZoom())
	else
		if p10.cameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Watch then
			return v14.CFrame, v14.Focus
		end

			local v27 = nil
			if v19 == v14.CFrame.p then
				warn("Camera cannot watch subject in same position as itself")
				return v14.CFrame, v14.Focus
			end

				local v29 = v19 - v14.CFrame.p
				v27 = v29.unit
				if p10.lastDistanceToSubject and p10.lastDistanceToSubject == p10:GetCameraToSubjectDistance() then
					p10:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v29.magnitude)
				end
			end
			local v30 = p10:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
			local v31 = p10:CalculateNewLookVectorFromArg(v27, v18)
			v16 = CFrame.new(v19)
			v15 = CFrame.new(v19 - v30 * v31, v19)

function v_u_4.UpdateImmersionCamera(p34, p35, _, _, _, p36) -- name: UpdateImmersionCamera
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2

	local v39 = v_u_1.LocalPlayer.Character

function v_u_4.UpdateThirdPersonComfortTransform(p68, p69, p70, p71, p72, p73) -- name: UpdateThirdPersonComfortTransform
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v74 = p68:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v75 = v74 < 0.5 and 0.5 or v74
	if p72 ~= nil and p68.lastCameraFocus ~= nil then
		local _ = v_u_1.LocalPlayer
		local v76 = p72 - p73
		local v77 = p68.controlModule:GetMoveVector()
		local v78 = v76.magnitude > 0.01 and true or v77.magnitude > 0.01
		if v78 then
			p68.motionDetTime = 0.1
		end
		p68.motionDetTime = p68.motionDetTime - p69
		if (p68.motionDetTime > 0 and true or v78) and not p68.needsReset then
			local v79 = p68.lastCameraFocus
			p68.VRCameraFocusFrozen = true
			return p70, v79
		end
		local v80 = p68.lastCameraResetPosition == nil and true or (p73 - p68.lastCameraResetPosition).Magnitude > 1
		local v81 = p68:getRotation(p69)
		if math.abs(v81) > 0 then
			local v82 = p71:ToObjectSpace(p70)
			p70 = p71 * CFrame.Angles(0, -v81, 0) * v82
		end
		if p68.VRCameraFocusFrozen and v80 or p68.needsReset then
			v_u_2:RecenterUserHeadCFrame()
			p68.VRCameraFocusFrozen = false
			p68.needsReset = false
			p68.lastCameraResetPosition = p73
			p68:ResetZoom()
			p68:StartFadeFromBlack()
			local v83 = p68:GetHumanoid()
			local v84 = v83.Torso and v83.Torso.CFrame.lookVector or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			local v85 = v84.X
			local v86 = v84.Z
			local v87 = Vector3.new(v85, 0, v86)
			local v88 = p71.Position - v87 * v75
			local v89 = p71.Position.X
			local v90 = v88.Y
			local v91 = p71.Position.Z
			local v92 = Vector3.new(v89, v90, v91)
			p70 = CFrame.new(v88, v92)
		end
	end

end
function v_u_4.UpdateThirdPersonFollowTransform(p93, p94, _, _, p95, p96) -- name: UpdateThirdPersonFollowTransform
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v97 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v98 = p93:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v99 = p93:GetVRFocus(p96, p94)
	if p93.needsReset then
		p93.needsReset = false
		v_u_2:RecenterUserHeadCFrame()
		p93:ResetZoom()
		p93:StartFadeFromBlack()
	end
	if p93.recentered then
		local v100 = p93:GetSubjectCFrame()
		if not v100 then
			return v97.CFrame, v97.Focus
		end
		local v101 = v99 * v100.Rotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, v98)
		p93.focusOffset = v99:ToObjectSpace(v101)
		p93.recentered = false
		return v101, v99
	end
	local v102 = v99:ToWorldSpace(p93.focusOffset)
	local _ = v_u_1.LocalPlayer
	local v103 = p95 - p96
	local v104 = p93.controlModule
	local v105 = v104:GetMoveVector()
	if v103.magnitude > 0.01 or v105.magnitude > 0 then
		local v106 = v104:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()
		local v107 = v106.Rotation + v106.Position * v97.HeadScale
		local v108 = v97.CFrame * v107
		local v109 = v108.LookVector
		local v110 = v109.X
		local v111 = v109.Z
		local v112 = Vector3.new(v110, 0, v111).Unit * v98
		local v113 = v99.Position - v112
		v102 = v102:Lerp(CFrame.new(v97.CFrame.Position + v113 - v108.Position) * v102.Rotation, 0.01)
	end
	local v114 = p93:getRotation(p94)
	if math.abs(v114) > 0 then
		local v115 = v99:ToObjectSpace(v102)
		v102 = v99 * CFrame.Angles(0, -v114, 0) * v115
	end
	p93.focusOffset = v99:ToObjectSpace(v102)
	local v116 = v102 * CFrame.new(0, 0, -v98)
	if (v116.Position - v97.Focus.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
		p93:StartVREdgeBlur(v_u_1.LocalPlayer)
	end
	return v102, v116
end

function v_u_1.GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame(p28) -- name: GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v29 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
	local _, v30, _ = v29:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v31 = -v30
	if v_u_8:GetUserCFrameEnabled(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand) and v_u_8:GetUserCFrameEnabled(Enum.UserCFrame.LeftHand) then
		local v32 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.LeftHand)
		local v33 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand)
		local v34 = v29.Position - v32.Position
		local v35 = v29.Position - v33.Position
		local v36 = v34.X
		local v37 = v34.Z
		local v38 = -math.atan2(v36, v37)
		local v39 = v35.X
		local v40 = v35.Z
		local v41 = (-math.atan2(v39, v40) - v38 + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v41 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v41 = v41 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v42 = (v38 + v41 / 2 + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v42 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v42 = v42 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v43 = (v31 - p28.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v43 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v43 = v43 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v44 = (v42 - p28.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v44 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v44 = v44 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v45
		if v44 > -1.5707963267948966 then
			v45 = v44 < 1.5707963267948966
		else
			v45 = false
		end
		if not v45 then
			v44 = v43
		end
		local v46 = math.min(v44, v43)
		local v47 = math.max(v44, v43)
		local v48 = 0
		if v46 > 0 then
			v47 = v46
		elseif v47 >= 0 then
			v47 = v48
		end
		p28.currentTorsoAngle = v47 + p28.currentTorsoAngle
	else
		p28.currentTorsoAngle = v31
	end
	return CFrame.new(v29.Position) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0, -p28.currentTorsoAngle, 0)
end

function v_u_1.calculateRawMoveVector(p63, p64, p65) -- name: calculateRawMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_62
	local v66 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v66 then
		return p65
	end
	local v67 = v66.CFrame
	if v_u_8.VREnabled and p64.RootPart then
		v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
		local v68 = p63:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()
		if (v66.Focus.Position - v67.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
			v67 = v67 * v68
		else
			v67 = v66.CFrame * (v68.Rotation + v68.Position * v66.HeadScale)
		end
	end
	if p64:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		local _, _, _, v73, v70, v71, _, _, v72, _, _, v73 = v67:GetComponents()
		if v72 >= 1 or v72 <= -1 then
			v71 = -v70 * math.sign(v72)
		end
		local v74 = v73 * v73 + v71 * v71
		local v75 = math.sqrt(v74)
		local v76 = (v73 * p65.X + v71 * p65.Z) / v75
		local v77 = (v73 * p65.Z - v71 * p65.X) / v75
		return Vector3.new(v76, 0, v77)
	end
	if not v_u_8.VREnabled then
		return v67:VectorToWorldSpace(p65)
	end
	local v78 = p65.X
	local v79 = p65.Z
	local v80 = Vector3.new(v78, 0, v79)
	if v80.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v81 = -v_u_62().Y * 1.3962634015954636
	local v82 = -v80.X
	local v83 = -v80.Z
	local v84 = math.atan2(v82, v83)
	local _, v85, _ = v67:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v86 = v84 + v85
	return CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(v81, v86, 0).LookVector
end
function v_u_1.OnRenderStepped(p87, p88) -- name: OnRenderStepped

	end
end

function v_u_17.OnNavigationRequest(p39, p40, _) -- name: OnNavigationRequest

				p39:GoToPoint(p39.currentDestination)

				if moving then
					p39.currentPoints[#currentPoints] = p39.currentDestination

	end

function v_u_17.OnHeartbeat(p61, p62) -- name: OnHeartbeat
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14
	local v63 = p61.moveVector
	local v64 = p61:GetLocalHumanoid()

			if v67 < 1 then

				local v70 = 0

					p61:StopFollowingPath()

				end

				end
				expectedTimeToNextPoint = (currentPoints[1] - v65).magnitude / v64.WalkSpeed
				timeReachedLastPoint = tick()
			else

			if v_u_128.Started then
				return
			else
				v_u_128.Started = true
				v_u_24.CancelFailureAnimation()
				if v_u_16 and (p175 == nil or p175) then
					local v176 = v_u_128
					local v177 = v_u_128
					local v178, v179 = v_u_24.CreatePathDisplay(v_u_128.pointList, v_u_128.OriginalTargetPoint)
					v176.stopTraverseFunc = v178
					v177.setPointFunc = v179
				end
				if #v_u_128.pointList > 0 then
					local v180 = v_u_128
					local v181 = v_u_128.pointList[1].Position.Y - v_u_128.OriginPoint.Y
					v180.HumanoidOffsetFromPath = Vector3.new(0, v181, 0)
					v_u_128.CurrentHumanoidPosition = v_u_128.Humanoid.RootPart.Position + v_u_128.HumanoidOffsetFromPath
					v_u_128.CurrentHumanoidVelocity = v_u_128.Humanoid.RootPart.Velocity
					v_u_128.SeatedConn = v_u_128.Humanoid.Seated:Connect(function(_, _)
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_128
						v_u_128:OnPathInterrupted()
					end)
					v_u_128.DiedConn = v_u_128.Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_128
						v_u_128:OnPathInterrupted()
					end)
					v_u_128.TeleportedConn = v_u_128.Humanoid.RootPart:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_128
						v_u_128:OnPathInterrupted()
					end)
					v_u_128.CurrentPoint = 1
					v_u_128:OnPointReached(true)
				else
					v_u_128.PathFailed:Fire()
					if v_u_128.stopTraverseFunc then
						v_u_128.stopTraverseFunc()
					end
				end
			end
		else
			v_u_128.PathFailed:Fire()
			return
		end
	end
	local v182 = v_u_128.TargetPoint + v_u_128.TargetSurfaceNormal * 1.5
	v_u_124()
	local v183 = workspace:Raycast(v182, Vector3.new(0, -50, 0), v_u_22)
	if v183 ~= nil then
		v_u_128.TargetPoint = v183.Position
	end
	v_u_128:ComputePath()
	return v_u_128
end

		end

	p191:Start(p_u_195)
	v_u_189 = p191.Finished.Event:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190, (copy) p_u_193, (ref) v_u_187, (copy) p_u_194

		end
		local v196 = p_u_193 and v_u_187(p_u_194)
		if v196 then

		end
	end)
	v_u_190 = p191.PathFailed.Event:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190, (copy) p_u_195, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_24, (copy) p_u_192
		if v_u_188 then

			v_u_190 = nil
		end
		if p_u_195 == nil or p_u_195 then
			local v197 = v_u_17
			if v197 then
				local v198 = v_u_188
				if v198 then
					v198 = v_u_188:IsActive()
				end
				v197 = not v198
			end

				v_u_24.PlayFailureAnimation()
			end

function OnTap(p200, p201, p202) -- name: OnTap
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_124, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190, (copy) v_u_184, (copy) v_u_199, (ref) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_187
	local v203 = v_u_11.CurrentCamera
	local v204 = v_u_23.Character
	local v205 = v_u_23
	local v206
	if v205 then
		v206 = v205.Character
	else
		v206 = v205
	end
	local v207
	if v206 then
		v207 = v_u_40[v205]
		if not v207 or v207.Parent ~= v206 then
			v_u_40[v205] = nil
			v207 = v206:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if v207 then
				v_u_40[v205] = v207
			end
		end
	else
		v207 = nil
	end
	local v208
	if v207 == nil then
		v208 = false
	else
		v208 = v207.Health > 0
	end
	if v208 then
		if #p200 == 1 or p201 then
			if v203 then
				local v209 = v203:ScreenPointToRay(p200[1].X, p200[1].Y)
				local v210 = v209.Origin
				local v211 = v209.Direction * 1000
				v_u_124()
				local v212 = workspace:Raycast(v210, v211, v_u_22)
				local v213
				if v212 == nil then
					v213 = nil
				else
					v213 = v212.Position
				end
				local v214 = v_u_23
				local v215
				if v214 then
					v215 = v214.Character
				else
					v215 = v214
				end
				if v215 then
					local v216 = v_u_40[v214]
					if not v216 or v216.Parent ~= v215 then
						v_u_40[v214] = nil
						local v217 = v215:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if v217 then
							v_u_40[v214] = v217
						end
					end
				end
				local v218 = v_u_25.FindCharacterAncestor
				local v219
				if v212 == nil then
					v219 = nil
				else
					v219 = v212.Instance
				end
				local v220, v221 = v218(v219)
				if p202 and (v221 and (v_u_10:GetCore("AvatarContextMenuEnabled") and v_u_9:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v221.Parent))) then
					if v_u_188 then
						v_u_188:Cancel()
						v_u_188 = nil
					end
					if v_u_189 then
						v_u_189:Disconnect()
						v_u_189 = nil
					end
					if v_u_190 then
						v_u_190:Disconnect()
						v_u_190 = nil
					end
					return
				end
				if p201 then
					v220 = nil
				else
					p201 = v213
				end
				if p201 and v204 then
					if v_u_188 then
						v_u_188:Cancel()
						v_u_188 = nil
					end
					if v_u_189 then
						v_u_189:Disconnect()
						v_u_189 = nil
					end
					if v_u_190 then
						v_u_190:Disconnect()
						v_u_190 = nil
					end
					local v222 = v_u_184(p201, v212 == nil and Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) or v212.Normal)
					if v222:IsValidPath() then
						v_u_199(v222, p201, v220, v204)
					else
						v222:Cleanup()
						if v_u_188 and v_u_188:IsActive() then
							v_u_188:Cancel()
						end
						if v_u_17 then
							v_u_24.PlayFailureAnimation()
						end
						v_u_24.DisplayFailureWaypoint(p201)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			local v223 = #p200 >= 2 and (v203 and v_u_187(v204))
			if v223 then
				v223:Activate()
			end
		end
	end
end
local v_u_224 = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Keyboard"))

function v_u_225.new(p226) -- name: new

	v229.renderSteppedConn = nil
	v229.menuOpenedConnection = nil

	v229.wasdEnabled = false

end

function v_u_225.OnTouchBegan(p242, p243, p244) -- name: OnTouchBegan
	if p242.fingerTouches[p243] == nil and not p244 then
		p242.numUnsunkTouches = p242.numUnsunkTouches + 1
	end
	p242.fingerTouches[p243] = p244
end
function v_u_225.OnTouchChanged(p245, p246, p247) -- name: OnTouchChanged
	if p245.fingerTouches[p246] == nil then
		p245.fingerTouches[p246] = p247
		if not p247 then
			p245.numUnsunkTouches = p245.numUnsunkTouches + 1
		end
	end
end
function v_u_225.OnTouchEnded(p248, p249, _) -- name: OnTouchEnded
	if p248.fingerTouches[p249] ~= nil and p248.fingerTouches[p249] == false then
		p248.numUnsunkTouches = p248.numUnsunkTouches - 1
	end
	p248.fingerTouches[p249] = nil
end
function v_u_225.OnPreferredInputChanged(_) -- name: OnPreferredInputChanged
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_7
	local v250 = v_u_23.Character
	if v250 then
		local v251 = v_u_7.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch
		for _, v252 in pairs(v250:GetChildren()) do
			if v252:IsA("Tool") then
				v252.ManualActivationOnly = v251
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_225.OnCharacterAdded(p_u_253, p254) -- name: OnCharacterAdded
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_13
	p_u_253:DisconnectEvents()
	p_u_253.inputBeganConn = v_u_7.InputBegan:Connect(function(p255, p256)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_253, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190, (ref) v_u_24
		if p255.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			p_u_253:OnTouchBegan(p255, p256)
		end
		if p_u_253.wasdEnabled and (p256 == false and (p255.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and v_u_21[p255.KeyCode])) then
			if v_u_188 then
				v_u_188:Cancel()
				v_u_188 = nil
			end
			if v_u_189 then
				v_u_189:Disconnect()
				v_u_189 = nil
			end
			if v_u_190 then
				v_u_190:Disconnect()
				v_u_190 = nil
			end
			v_u_24.CancelFailureAnimation()
		end
		if p255.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			p_u_253.mouse2DownTime = tick()
			p_u_253.mouse2DownPos = p255.Position
		end
	end)
	p_u_253.inputChangedConn = v_u_7.InputChanged:Connect(function(p257, p258)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_253
		if p257.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			p_u_253:OnTouchChanged(p257, p258)
		end
	end)
	p_u_253.inputEndedConn = v_u_7.InputEnded:Connect(function(p259, p260)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_253, (ref) v_u_188
		if p259.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			p_u_253:OnTouchEnded(p259, p260)
		end
		if p259.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			p_u_253.mouse2UpTime = tick()
			local v261 = p259.Position
			local v262 = v_u_188 or p_u_253.keyboardMoveVector.Magnitude <= 0
			if p_u_253.mouse2UpTime - p_u_253.mouse2DownTime < 0.25 and ((v261 - p_u_253.mouse2DownPos).magnitude < 5 and v262) then
				OnTap({ v261 })
			end
		end
	end)
	p_u_253.tapConn = v_u_7.TouchTap:Connect(function(p263, p264)
		if not p264 then
			OnTap(p263, nil, true)
		end
	end)
	p_u_253.menuOpenedConnection = v_u_13.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190
		if v_u_188 then
			v_u_188:Cancel()
			v_u_188 = nil
		end
		if v_u_189 then
			v_u_189:Disconnect()
			v_u_189 = nil
		end
		if v_u_190 then
			v_u_190:Disconnect()
			v_u_190 = nil
		end
	end)
	local function v_u_267(p265) -- name: OnCharacterChildAdded
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (copy) p_u_253
		if v_u_7.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch and p265:IsA("Tool") then
			p265.ManualActivationOnly = true
		end
		if p265:IsA("Humanoid") then
			local v266 = p_u_253.humanoidDiedConn
			if v266 then
				v266:Disconnect()
			end
			p_u_253.humanoidDiedConn = p265.Died:Connect(function() end)
		end
	end
	p_u_253.characterChildAddedConn = p254.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p268)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_267
		v_u_267(p268)
	end)
	p_u_253.characterChildRemovedConn = p254.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(p269)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7
		if v_u_7.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch and p269:IsA("Tool") then
			p269.ManualActivationOnly = false
		end
	end)
	for _, v270 in pairs(p254:GetChildren()) do
		v_u_267(v270)
	end
	p_u_253.preferredInputChangedConnection = v_u_7:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_253
		p_u_253:OnPreferredInputChanged()
	end)
end

function v_u_225.Enable(p_u_273, p274, p275, p276) -- name: Enable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_188, (ref) v_u_189, (ref) v_u_190, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_224
	if p274 then
		if not p_u_273.running then
			if v_u_23.Character then
				p_u_273:OnCharacterAdded(v_u_23.Character)
			end
			p_u_273.onCharacterAddedConn = v_u_23.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(p277)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_273
				p_u_273:OnCharacterAdded(p277)
			end)
			p_u_273.running = true
		end
		p_u_273.touchJumpController = p276
		if p_u_273.touchJumpController then
			p_u_273.touchJumpController:Enable(p_u_273.jumpEnabled)
		end
	else
		if p_u_273.running then
			p_u_273:DisconnectEvents()
			if v_u_188 then
				v_u_188:Cancel()
				v_u_188 = nil
			end
			if v_u_189 then
				v_u_189:Disconnect()
				v_u_189 = nil
			end
			if v_u_190 then
				v_u_190:Disconnect()
				v_u_190 = nil
			end
			if v_u_7.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then
				local v278 = v_u_23.Character
				if v278 then
					for _, v279 in pairs(v278:GetChildren()) do
						if v279:IsA("Tool") then
							v279.ManualActivationOnly = false
						end
					end
				end
			end
			p_u_273.running = false
		end
		if p_u_273.touchJumpController and not p_u_273.jumpEnabled then
			p_u_273.touchJumpController:Enable(true)
		end
		p_u_273.touchJumpController = nil
	end
	v_u_224.Enable(p_u_273, p274)
	p_u_273.wasdEnabled = p274 and p275 and p275 or false
	p_u_273.enabled = p274
end
function v_u_225.OnRenderStepped(p280, p281) -- name: OnRenderStepped
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188
	p280.isJumping = false
	if v_u_188 then
		v_u_188:OnRenderStepped(p281)
		if v_u_188 then
			p280.moveVector = v_u_188.NextActionMoveDirection
			p280.moveVectorIsCameraRelative = false
			if v_u_188.NextActionJump then
				p280.isJumping = true
			end
		else
			p280.moveVector = p280.keyboardMoveVector
			p280.moveVectorIsCameraRelative = true
		end
	else
		p280.moveVector = p280.keyboardMoveVector
		p280.moveVectorIsCameraRelative = true
	end
	if p280.jumpRequested then
		p280.isJumping = true
	end
end
function v_u_225.UpdateMovement(p282, p283) -- name: UpdateMovement
	if p283 == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		p282.keyboardMoveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	elseif p282.wasdEnabled then
		local v284 = p282.leftValue + p282.rightValue
		local v285 = p282.forwardValue + p282.backwardValue
		p282.keyboardMoveVector = Vector3.new(v284, 0, v285)
	end
end

function v_u_1.ActivateCameraController(p63, p64, p65) -- name: ActivateCameraController

		if p65 == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then

				p63.activeCameraController = nil
			end

		end
		if p65 == Enum.CameraType.Custom then

		elseif p65 == Enum.CameraType.Follow then

		elseif p65 == Enum.CameraType.Orbital then

			v66 = v_u_18
		elseif p64 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic or (p64 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow or (p64 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Default or p64 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.CameraToggle)) then
			v66 = v_u_14
		else

				warn("ActivateCameraController did not select a module.")
				return
			end

		end
	end

		if v_u_7.VREnabled then

		end
	end

				v67:Reset()
			end
		elseif v67.Reset then
			v67:Reset()
		end
	else

		v_u_24[v66] = v67

			if not p63.activeCameraController:GetEnabled() then
				p63.activeCameraController:Enable(p63.cameraEnabled)
			end

		end

		p63.activeCameraController = v67
		local v68 = p63.activeCameraController
		assert(v68, "Strict typing check")

	end
	if p63.activeCameraController then
		if v_u_28 then
			p63.activeCameraController:SetCameraMovementMode(p64)
			p63.activeCameraController:SetCameraType(p65)

	end
end

		local v68 = v67.Rotation + v67.Position * v63.HeadScale
		local v69 = v63.CFrame * v68
		local _, v70, _ = v69:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		local _, v71, _ = v66:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		local v72 = (v70 - p60.currentDriftAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v72 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v72 = v72 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v73 = (v71 - p60.currentDriftAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v73 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v73 = v73 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v74 = math.min(v73, v72)
		local v75 = math.max(v73, v72)
		local v76 = 0
		if v74 > 0 then
			v75 = v74
		elseif v75 >= 0 then
			v75 = v76
		end
		p60.currentDriftAngle = v75 + p60.currentDriftAngle
		local v77 = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0, p60.currentDriftAngle, 0).LookVector
		local v78 = v77.X
		local v79 = v77.Z
		local v80 = Vector3.new(v78, 0, v79).Unit * v64
		local v81 = p62.Position - v80

function v_u_19.UpdateRotationCamera(p82, p83) -- name: UpdateRotationCamera
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_14
	local v84 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v85
	if v84 then
		v85 = v84.CameraSubject
	else
		v85 = v84
	end
	local v86 = p82.vehicleCameraCore
	assert(v84)
	assert(v85)
	assert(v85:IsA("VehicleSeat"))
	local v87 = p82:GetSubjectCFrame()
	local v88 = p82:GetSubjectVelocity()
	local v89 = p82:GetSubjectRotVelocity()
	local v90 = v88:Dot(v87.ZVector)
	local v91 = math.abs(v90)
	local v92 = v87.YVector:Dot(v89)
	local v93 = math.abs(v92)
	local v94 = v87.XVector:Dot(v89)
	local v95 = math.abs(v94)
	local v96 = p82:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v97 = v_u_16(v96, 0.5, p82.assemblyRadius, 1, 0)
	local v98 = p82:_GetThirdPersonLocalOffset():Lerp(p82:_GetFirstPersonLocalOffset(v87), v97)
	v86:setTransform(v87)
	local v99 = v86:step(p83, v95, v93, v97)
	local v100 = p82:_StepRotation(p83, v91)
	local v101 = p82:GetVRFocus(v87 * v98, p83) * v99 * v100
	local v102 = v101 * CFrame.new(0, 0, v96)
	if v88.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		p82:StartVREdgeBlur(v_u_14)
	end

end
function v_u_19.UpdateStepRotation(p103, p104) -- name: UpdateStepRotation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_14
	local v105 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v106 = p103.lastSubjectCFrame
	local v107 = p103:GetSubjectCFrame()
	local v108 = p103:GetSubjectVelocity()
	local v109 = p103:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v110 = v_u_16(v109, 0.5, p103.assemblyRadius, 1, 0)
	local v111 = p103:_GetThirdPersonLocalOffset():Lerp(p103:_GetFirstPersonLocalOffset(v107), v110)
	local v112 = p103:GetVRFocus(v107 * v111, p104)
	local v113, v114 = p103:addDrift(v112:ToWorldSpace(p103:GetVRFocus(v106 * v111, p104):ToObjectSpace(v105.CFrame)), v112)
	local v115 = p103:getRotation(p104)
	local v116
	if math.abs(v115) > 0 then
		local v117 = v114:ToObjectSpace(v113)
		v116 = v114 * CFrame.Angles(0, -v115, 0) * v117
		if not v_u_5.VRSmoothRotationEnabled then
			local v118 = v_u_13:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
			local v119 = v118.Rotation + v118.Position * v105.HeadScale
			local v120 = v114 * v107.Rotation
			local v121 = v120:ToObjectSpace(v113 * v119)
			local v122 = v121.X
			local v123 = v121.Z
			local v124 = Vector3.new(v122, 0, v123).Unit:Dot(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
			local v125 = math.acos(v124)
			local v126 = v120:ToObjectSpace(v116 * v119)
			local v127 = v126.X
			local v128 = v126.Z
			local v129 = Vector3.new(v127, 0, v128).Unit:Dot(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
			if math.acos(v129) < v125 then
				if v115 < 0 then
					v125 = v125 * -1
				end
				v116 = v114 * CFrame.Angles(0, -v125, 0) * v117
			end
		end
	else
		v116 = v113
	end
	if v108.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		p103:StartVREdgeBlur(v_u_14)
	end
	if p103.needsReset then
		p103.needsReset = false
		v_u_13:RecenterUserHeadCFrame()
		p103:StartFadeFromBlack()
		p103:ResetZoom()
	end
	if p103.recentered then
		v116 = v114 * v107.Rotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, v109)
		p103.recentered = false
	end
	return v116, v116 * CFrame.new(0, 0, -v109)
end
function v_u_19.UpdateComfortCamera(p130, p131) -- name: UpdateComfortCamera
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_14
	local v132 = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if v132 then
		v133 = v132.CameraSubject

		v133 = v132

	local v134 = p130.vehicleCameraCore

		p131 = v_u_18

	local v135 = p130:GetSubjectCFrame()
	local v136 = p130:GetSubjectVelocity()

	local v139 = v135.YVector:Dot(v137)

	local v142 = math.abs(v141)

	v134:setTransform(v135)

		p130:UpdateFadeFromBlack(p131)

	if p130:IsInFirstPerson() then
		local v149 = v146.LookVector.X

		local v151 = Vector3.new(v149, 0, v150).Unit

		if v_u_3 then

				p130:StartVREdgeBlur(v_u_14)
			end
		else
			p130:StartVREdgeBlur(v_u_14)
		end
	else

		["freq"] = nil,
		["goal"] = nil,

		["goal"] = p7,
		["pos"] = p7

function v_u_5.step(p9, p10) -- name: step
	local v11 = p9.freq * 2 * 3.141592653589793
	local v12 = p9.goal
	local v13 = p9.pos
	local v14 = p9.vel
	local v15 = v13 - v12
	local v16 = -v11 * p10
	local v17 = math.exp(v16)
	local v18 = (v15 * (v11 * p10 + 1) + v14 * p10) * v17 + v12
	local v19 = (v14 * (1 - v11 * p10) - v15 * (v11 * v11 * p10)) * v17
	p9.pos = v18
	p9.vel = v19
	return v18
end

function v_u_4.map(p20, p21, p22, p23, p24) -- name: map

end
function v_u_4.mapClamp(p25, p26, p27, p28, p29) -- name: mapClamp
	local v30 = (p25 - p26) * (p29 - p28) / (p27 - p26) + p28
	local v31 = math.min(p28, p29)
	local v32 = math.max(p28, p29)

end
function v_u_4.getLooseBoundingSphere(p33) -- name: getLooseBoundingSphere
	local v34 = table.create(#p33)
	for v35, v36 in pairs(p33) do
		v34[v35] = v36.Position
	end
	local v37 = v34[1]
	local v38 = v37
	local v39 = 0
	for _, v40 in ipairs(v34) do
		local v41 = (v40 - v37).Magnitude
		if v39 < v41 then
			v38 = v40
			v39 = v41
		end
	end
	local v42 = v38
	local v43 = 0
	for _, v44 in ipairs(v34) do
		local v45 = (v44 - v38).Magnitude
		if v43 < v45 then
			v42 = v44
			v43 = v45
		end
	end
	local v46 = (v38 + v42) * 0.5
	local v47 = (v38 - v42).Magnitude * 0.5
	for _, v48 in ipairs(v34) do

function v_u_1._positionVelocity(p37, p38) -- name: _positionVelocity
	local v39 = p37._position0
	local v40 = p37._velocity0
	local v41 = p37._target
	local v42 = p37._damper
	local v43 = p37._speed
	local v44 = v43 * (p38 - p37._time0)
	local v45 = v42 * v42
	local v46, v47, v48
	if v45 < 1 then
		local v49 = 1 - v45
		v46 = math.sqrt(v49)
		local v50 = -v42 * v44
		local v51 = math.exp(v50) / v46
		local v52 = v46 * v44
		v47 = v51 * math.cos(v52)
		local v53 = v46 * v44
		v48 = v51 * math.sin(v53)
	elseif v45 == 1 then
		v46 = 1
		local v54 = -v42 * v44
		v47 = math.exp(v54) / v46
		v48 = v47 * v44
	else
		local v55 = v45 - 1
		v46 = math.sqrt(v55)
		local v56 = (-v42 + v46) * v44
		local v57 = math.exp(v56) / (2 * v46)
		local v58 = (-v42 - v46) * v44
		local v59 = math.exp(v58) / (2 * v46)
		v47 = v57 + v59
		v48 = v57 - v59
	end
	local v60 = v46 * v47 + v42 * v48
	local v61 = 1 - (v46 * v47 + v42 * v48)
	local v62 = v48 / v43
	local v63 = -v43 * v48
	local v64 = v43 * v48
	local v65 = v46 * v47 - v42 * v48
	return v60 * v39 + v61 * v41 + v62 * v40, v63 * v39 + v64 * v41 + v65 * v40
end

local function v_u_5(p1, p2, p3) -- name: weightedRoll
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v4
	if p2 then
		v4 = p2 > 0 and -math.random(p2) or p2 < 0 and (select(2, next(p1, p3)) >= -p2 and next(p1, p3) or v_u_5(p1, p2 + select(2, next(p1, p3)), next(p1, p3))) or next(p1, p3) and select(2, next(p1, p3)) + v_u_5(p1, 0, next(p1, p3))
		if not v4 then
			return 0
		end
	else
		v4 = v_u_5(p1, v_u_5(p1, v_u_5(p1, 0)))
	end
	return v4
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5
	local v7 = p6.Instance:FindFirstChild("CollisionParts") or Instance.new("Folder")

	local v8 = p6.Instance:FindFirstChild("NoCollisionConstraints") or Instance.new("Folder")

	else

	end
	if v11 == nil then
		v11 = v_u_2.LobbyGroup
	end
	local v12 = {
		["Direction"] = p6.Data:GetAttribute("Direction"),
		["Effect"] = p6.Data:GetAttribute("Effect") or "Default",
		["Hit"] = p6.Data:GetAttribute("Hit"),

		["Weapon"] = p6.Data:GetAttribute("Weapon"),
		["Origin"] = p6.Data:GetAttribute("Origin"),

	}

		["CollisionParts"] = nil,

================================================================================
applyHitForce | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Ragdoll.applyHitForce
================================================================================

local v_u_1 = Random.new()
return function(p2, p3) -- name: applyHitForce
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p3 == nil or (p3.Direction == nil or p3.Hit == nil) then
		if p2.Client == true then
			p2:AddLinearVelocity(v_u_1:NextUnitVector() * 20)
			p2:AddAngularVelocity(v_u_1:NextUnitVector() * 10)
		end
	else
		local v4 = p2.Limbs[p3.TargetName]
		if v4 == nil then
			p2:ApplyStandardForce(p3.Direction, p3.Hit)
			return
		end
		if p3.Weapon == "Explosion" then
			v4:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(p3.Direction * 50 * v4.Mass, p3.Hit)
			return
		end
	end
end

================================================================================
removeRigTextures | Type: ModuleScript | Method: decompile
Location: ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Ragdoll.removeRigTextures
================================================================================

return function(p1) -- name: removeRigTextures
	for _, v2 in p1:GetDescendants() do
		if v2:IsA("MeshPart") then
			if v2:FindFirstChildOfClass("WrapLayer") then
				v2:Destroy()
			else
				v2.TextureID = ""
				local v3 = v2:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if v3 ~= nil then
					v3:Destroy()
				end
			end
		elseif v2:IsA("Shirt") or (v2:IsA("Pants") or v2:IsA("ShirtGraphic")) then
			v2:Destroy()
		elseif v2:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
			v2.TextureId = ""
		end
	end
end

function v_u_50.OpenFrame(p123, p124, p125) -- name: OpenFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_29
	if p123.CloseLock == true or p123.Loaded == false then
		return
	else
		local _ = p124 == v_u_21.PunishmentPanel
		local _ = p124 == v_u_21.ServerBrowser
		if p124.Visible ~= true and p123.ActiveFrames[p124] ~= true then
			if p125 ~= true then
				p123:PlaySound(v_u_29.UI.Click)
			end
			for _, v126 in p123.CloseFrames do
				v126.Visible = false
				p123.ActiveFrames[v126] = nil
			end
			p123.ActiveFrames[p124] = true
			p124.Visible = true
		end
	end
end

	p_u_229._rewardTrove:Destroy()

	end

	end

	else
		v_u_337.Stats.Result.Stat.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	v_u_337.StreakNotice.Visible = p336
	v_u_337.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, v_u_337.Size.X.Offset + v_u_21.Main.UIPadding.PaddingBottom.Offset)

function v_u_50.SpeakLabel(p340, p341) -- name: SpeakLabel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29
	for v342 = 1, #p341.Text do
		p341.MaxVisibleGraphemes = v342
		p340:PlaySound(v_u_29.UI.Speak)
		local v343 = p341.Text
		local v344 = string.sub(v343, v342, v342)
		local v345 = p341.Text
		local v346 = v342 - 1
		local v347 = v342 - 1
		local v348 = string.sub(v345, v346, v347)
		local v349 = v344 == " " and (v348 == "!" or (v348 == "?" or (v348 == "." or v348 == ","))) and 0.5 or 0.03333333333333333
		task.wait(v349)
	end
end
